description: List defects (bugs) raised in the connected project — id/code, title, state, severity, priority, assignee(s), and which test case(s) each is linked to. Mirrors the filters on the product's Defect list page: `search` (title keyword), `tcId` (defects against one test case), `storyId` (defects on one user story), `state` (workflow state — use the exact `state` value from an existing defect_list row, e.g. "new"/"open"/"closed", not the capitalized UI label), `assignedTo` / `createdBy` (numeric userId, or "me" — resolve a name to an id via list_users first). The Defect list page also lets a user filter by MANY MORE project-configured columns (Module, Release, Feature, Team, Client, Labels, custom fields, ...) that vary per project — pass those via `filters: [{ column, value }]` (raw column filters, appended as-is; use the field's backend key, e.g. `moduleId`/`releaseId`/`featureId`/`teamId`/`clientId`/`tags`). Omit everything for the full project list. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Read-only and product-neutral. When presenting this as a table, label the columns "ID" and "Name" — the underlying fields are literally named `code`/`title`, but that's internal wire terminology, not what to show the user.

assignedTo.description: Numeric userId of the assignee. Pass "me" for the current caller. Resolve names via list_users first.

createdBy.description: Numeric userId of the creator. Pass "me" for the current caller. Resolve names via list_users first.

filters.description: Extra raw column filters for project-configured columns with no dedicated parameter above (Module/Release/Feature/Team/Client/Labels/custom fields).

column.description: Backend field name to filter on, e.g. "priority", "moduleId", "customFields.Team".

regEx.description: Substring/regex match instead of exact equality.

value.description: Exact-match value (or substring when `regEx` is true).

search.description: Keyword to find defects by title.

state.description: Exact workflow state key (e.g. "new", "open", "closed") — from an existing row's `state` value, not the capitalized UI label.

storyId.description: Only defects linked to this user story (id or business key).

tcId.description: Only defects raised against this test case (id or business key).

name: defect_list
title: List / search defects (bugs)
